info.name:
Calculate values for a refund of all refundable items of an order at once,
i.e. using the RefundOrder method.

items.docs:
Known errors:
- UNAUTHENTICATED
  - when no authorization header is sent
  - when authorization header is malformed or invalid
- PERMISSION_DENIED
  - when the authorized user does not have permissions for this operation
- NOT_FOUND
  - when the order is not found
- INVALID_ARGUMENT
  - invalid input refund data is provided
- FAILED_PRECONDITION
  - when order is not refundable
- RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED
  - when rate limit is exceeded

info.name: Uploads a commercial invoice for an order.

items.docs:
This document is required for customs when shipping internationally (e.g., outside the EU), and must be provided
before shipping the order. The document must be in PDF.
Intra-EU orders (e.g., non-CH orders) are not eligible for commercial invoice upload.
If a commercial invoice was already uploaded, the call will return an error.
